companyDescription: Psychedelic psychiatry · HLP003 (deuterated psilocybin analog, formerly CYB003) in Phase 3 for major depressive disorder. APPROACH topline Q4 2026, EMBRACE second pivotal enrolling, NDA targeted 2028; HLP004 (deuterated DMT) in Phase 2 for GAD
priceNote: Live $10.31 (+1.2%) at Oct 26, 2026 open. 52-week range $3.76-$15.15 — +174% off the low, -32% off the high. Market cap ~$753M on 73.1M shares; $166.4M cash at Jun 30 after the $50M June raise at $4.85.
summary: Helus (formerly Cybin) reports Phase 3 APPROACH topline for HLP003 in adjunctive MDD by year-end 2026. This is the first pivotal readout for a deuterated psilocybin analog, and its Phase 2 showed a ~23-point MADRS drop with 71% remission at 12 months. A clean win positions HLP003 as the leading short-session psychedelic for depression and supports the $41 consensus. The key risk is the CMPS lesson: a narrow win can still sell off 36-46% after a run like HELP's (+174% off the low). Survival check: $166.4M cash gives ~12-14 months of runway, so the flag is not tripped. The phase3_readout bucket is n=1 in turbo feedback (context only). Base (+55%) is far above the lane's realized 30-day P90 (+25.9%; written-Base bias +72.7pp). It assumes a decisive topline within ~1-3 months that clears the $15.15 high. แนะนำ 3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้าผลไม่ผ่าน ลงได้ 50-70%.

catalysts.name: APPROACH Phase 3 topline (HLP003, adjunctive MDD)
catalysts.description: First of two pivotal studies. Enrollment completed ahead of schedule. In Phase 2, two 16 mg doses produced a ~23-point MADRS reduction at 12 months, with 100% response and 71% remission. Company guides topline in Q4 2026 — exact date not announced.

catalysts.name: EMBRACE second pivotal + 2028 NDA
catalysts.description: Second Phase 3 in the PARADIGM program, still enrolling; funded by the Jun 2026 $50M raise. NDA targeted 2028.

risks: Sell-the-news risk: Compass Pathways hit its Phase 3 primary endpoint in Jun 2025 and still fell 36-46% on a modest effect size. HELP has run +174% off its low into this readout, so the bar for 'good enough' is high.
Runway is ~12-14 months on $166.4M cash (TTM net loss ~$171M). It clears the survival bar, but barely — expect a raise after positive data, and a punitive one after a miss.
Functional unblinding and expectancy effects are a known FDA concern for psychedelic trials and could complicate regulatory interpretation even if the topline is positive.
Regulatory precedent is mixed: FDA rejected Lykos's MDMA application in Aug 2024. Psychedelic approval paths remain untested at the NDA stage.
Exact topline date undisclosed ('Q4 2026'). If it slips into 2027, time decay and financing risk both rise.

estimateDates.note: Primary MADRS vs. placebo/control — magnitude matters more than the p-value (see CMPS 2025)

Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 ($8.75-9.50) is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: HELP is +414% YoY by market cap and +174% off its $3.76 low. The psychedelic sector has already re-rated into this readout, so a lot of good news is in the price, which is the CMPS 2025 setup.

postWin.note: Average of two real psychedelic positive-data reactions: atai (ATAI) +30% pre-market on Beckley's BPL-003 Phase 2b (Jul 2025), and Cybin itself +8% pre-market on CYB003 Phase 2 interim data (Nov 2023). Neither was a Phase 3, so a clean pivotal win could exceed this range.

postLose.note: Compass Pathways (CMPS) fell 36% pre-market and ~46% intraday on Jun 23, 2025 even though COMP005 HIT its primary endpoint — the effect (3.6-point MADRS separation) disappointed. An outright APPROACH miss would likely be worse than this.

spotSizing.reason: 3%. The largest-cap and best-funded of this run's picks (~$753M, $166M cash), with a Phase 2 effect size far above CMPS's. The phase3_readout bucket is n=1 in turbo feedback (context only), and the weak lane scoreboard (hitRate 4.9%, n=41) keeps it at 3%, not 5%.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the lane medianMAE (-24.1%). A pre-topline break below ~$7.50 likely signals a sector de-risking or a leak.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If the primary endpoint misses, or the effect size lands near CMPS's 3.6 points, exit on day 1. Don't wait for an EMBRACE rescue.

comparableCases.event: COMP005 Phase 3 psilocybin (TRD) hits primary endpoint
comparableCases.note: The key cautionary comp: a WIN that sold off 36-46% because the effect size (3.6 MADRS points) underwhelmed a crowded long base. HELP's Phase 2 effect was much larger, but the stock has also run harder into the event.
Clean positive psychedelic readout: +30% pre-market, with Jefferies calling for a 50-100% follow-through. The upside template for a decisive APPROACH result.
Same molecule (now HLP003): strong data produced only +8% pre-market when the company was a sub-$500M name. It shows how much the re-rating since then already prices in.

th.summary: Helus (ชื่อเดิม Cybin) จะประกาศผล topline Phase 3 APPROACH ของ HLP003 ใน MDD แบบเสริมภายในสิ้นปี 2026 — ผล pivotal แรกของ psilocybin analog แบบ deuterated ซึ่ง Phase 2 ให้ MADRS ลด ~23 จุด remission 71% ที่ 12 เดือน ถ้าชนะชัด HLP003 จะเป็นผู้นำยาไซคีเดลิกแบบ session สั้นสำหรับโรคซึมเศร้า และรองรับเป้าเฉลี่ย $41 ความเสี่ยงหลักคือบทเรียน CMPS: ชนะแบบเฉียดยังโดนขาย 36-46% หลังหุ้นวิ่งแรงแบบ HELP (+174% จากจุดต่ำ) ตรวจ survival: เงินสด $166.4M รันเวย์ ~12-14 เดือน ไม่เข้าเกณฑ์ธง ประเภท phase3_readout มี n=1 ใน turbo feedback (บริบทเท่านั้น) Base (+55%) สูงกว่า P90 ที่เกิดจริงมาก (+25.9%; bias +72.7pp) โดยสมมติผลชัดเจนในกรอบ 1-3 เดือนที่ทะลุ $15.15 แนะนำ 3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้าผลไม่ผ่าน ลงได้ 50-70%
